assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias.
The diagnosis of concern is paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The diagnosis of concern includes other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias.
The ICD-10 code I48.0 corresponds to paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The ICD-10 code I49.9 corresponds to other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias.
The Holter monitor is ordered to capture the rhythm during symptomatic periods.
The Holter monitor is ordered to assess the burden of arrhythmia for further management.
The CPT code for the 48-hour Holter monitor is 93226.
The study is medically necessary to document the rhythm during symptomatic episodes for the diagnosis of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The study is medically necessary to guide management.
